name: Songwriting Framework
description: Provides an intermediate-level framework for writing songs including song structure templates (verse, chorus, bridge, pre-chorus, intro, outro), lyric development processes (theme narrowing, imagery, rhyme scheme selection), melody-chord relationship basics, and revision techniques. Use when the user wants to write a song, develop lyrics, choose a song structure, or improve an existing song draft. Do NOT use for music theory fundamentals like scales and intervals (use music-theory-fundamentals), beginner guitar chords (use guitar-beginner-foundations), or recording and production (use home-recording-starter).
